description: A multi-layer social-network agent-based model where individuals decide daily whether to wear a mask based on prior behavior, risk perception, perceived norms within family/work/community layers, received information, and government mandates. Parameters are calibrated from days 0-29 and used to forecast days 30-39.

behaviors.name: UpdatePerceivedNorms
behaviors.description: Compute per-layer perceived norms as exponentially smoothed fractions of masked neighbors.

parameters.memory_decay: float in [0,1]; 0 uses only current day, 1 accumulates full history

behaviors.algorithm: For each layer L in {family, work_school, community}: frac_L(t) = (# neighbors in L wearing_mask at t-1) / max(1, degree_L). perceived_norm_L(t) = memory_decay * perceived_norm_L(t-1) + (1 - memory_decay) * frac_L(t). If degree_L == 0, carry forward perceived_norm_L(t-1) or default to global mean that day.

behaviors.name: DecideMaskWearing
behaviors.description: Update mask intention via a role-specific logistic policy, then sample wearing_mask ~ Bernoulli(mask_intent).
behaviors.algorithm: For agent i with occupation role R, compute z = b0_R + b_prev_R * mask_{t-1} + b_risk_R * risk_perception + wF_R * perceived_norm_family + wW_R * perceived_norm_work_school + wC_R * perceived_norm_community + b_info_R * received_info_t + b_man_R * mask_mandate_t + age_group_dummies. Optionally divide z by temperature. mask_intent = sigmoid(z). Draw wearing_mask_t ~ Bernoulli(mask_intent).

behaviors.name: ReceiveBroadcastInfo
behaviors.description: Governmental broadcast exposes targeted agents to information.

parameters.campaign_intensity: probability in [0,1] per targeted agent per day
parameters.targeting_rules: cohorts to target (e.g., by occupation, low adoption clusters, or all)

behaviors.algorithm: On day t, for each targeted agent i, set received_info_i,t = 1 with probability campaign_intensity(t); otherwise 0 unless already set by peer relay.

behaviors.name: RelayPeerInfo
behaviors.description: Informed agents may pass info to their neighbors as a per-edge stochastic event.
behaviors.algorithm: For each informed agent i and for each neighbor j across all layers, if received_info_i,t == 1 then set received_info_j,t = 1 with probability gamma_info (if not already 1).

behaviors.name: RespondToMandate
behaviors.description: Mandate adds a positive shift in the adoption logit; optional occupation multipliers for compliance.
behaviors.algorithm: mask_mandate_t provided by GovernmentBroadcaster. Contribution b_man_R * mask_mandate_t is added to z in DecideMaskWearing; optionally scale by occupation multiplier.

interactions.name: PeerInfluenceByLayer
interactions.description: Per-layer social influence via perceived norms computed from neighbors' mask states.
interactions.effect: Adjusts adoption logit via wF, wW, wC times perceived norms.

interactions.name: InformationBroadcast
interactions.description: Exogenous information exposure from GovernmentBroadcaster to agents.
interactions.effect: Sets received_info=1 for exposed agents; increases adoption via b_info.

interactions.name: PeerInformationRelay
interactions.description: Informed agents can inform neighbors over existing edges.
interactions.effect: Spreads received_info to neighbors with probability gamma_info per edge.

interactions.name: MandateEffect
interactions.description: System-wide mandate that increases adoption propensity.
interactions.trigger: time (from day 10 onward or per schedule)
interactions.effect: Adds b_man to logit; optional enforcement boosts work/school weight.

b0.description: Baseline bias (intercept) for logistic adoption; role-specific variants allowed

b_prev.description: Inertia of prior-day mask wearing; role-specific

b_risk.description: Effect of risk_perception on adoption; role-specific

wF.description: Influence weight of family norms; role-specific

wW.description: Influence weight of work/school norms; role-specific

wC.description: Influence weight of community norms; role-specific

b_info.description: Effect of received_info on adoption; role-specific

age_group_multipliers.description: Additive adjustments to logit by age_group

occupation_multipliers.description: Adjustments by occupation (either on intercept or layer weights)

memory_decay.description: Smoothing of perceived norms over days

campaign_intensity.description: Daily broadcast exposure probability for targeted agents

temperature.description: Decision noise scaling (higher equals more randomness)

contact_layer_weights_enforcement_boost.description: Optional multiplier on wW during mandate to represent enforcement

initialization.population_size: Number of unique agent_ids in intersection of agent_attributes.csv and social_network.json keys

calibration.holdout_strategy: temporal_holdout within days 0-29 for model selection; final refit on days 0-29 for forecasting 30-39

algorithms.NetworkBuildAndValidation: Load social_network.json; for each agent, parse lists into sets per layer; symmetrize: if u lists v in any layer, add undirected edge in that layer; deduplicate; compute degrees; compare to agent_attributes.csv degree columns; log discrepancies; proceed with network.json as authoritative for edges.
algorithms.PerceivedNormsUpdate: For each agent and layer L, compute frac_L(t) from neighbors' wearing_mask at t-1; update perceived_norm_L(t) via exponential smoothing using memory_decay.
algorithms.RoleSpecificLogisticPolicy: Estimate logistic regressions per occupation role: wear_t ~ mask_{t-1} + risk_perception + perc_norm_family + perc_norm_work_school + perc_norm_community + received_info_t + mandate_t + age_group_dummies. Use statsmodels or sklearn with L2 regularization (C chosen via inner temporal CV) and clustered SEs optional. If some roles have few samples, use hierarchical shrinkage to a global model.
algorithms.InformationDynamics: On day t: (1) Broadcast: for targeted agents, set received_info=Bernoulli(campaign_intensity(t)); (2) Peer relay: for each informed agent, for each neighbor across layers, set neighbor.received_info=1 with probability gamma_info; ensure received_info is binary OR of sources.
algorithms.DailySimulationStep: Order per day t: (a) Set mask_mandate_t from schedule; (b) Apply BroadcastInfo; (c) Apply PeerInformationRelay; (d) UpdatePerceivedNorms using t-1 states; (e) DecideMaskWearing for all agents to get wearing_mask_t; (f) Log outputs.
algorithms.CalibrationProcedure: Compute perceived norms for days 1..29 using observed wearing_mask(t-1) to align predictors; fit role-specific logistic models on training portion (0..floor(0.8*T)-1); select hyperparameters via temporal holdout; then refit on all days 0..29 with chosen settings for final forecasting.
algorithms.Forecasting: Initialize at end of day 29 with observed wearing_mask_29; simulate days 30..39 using calibrated parameters and scenario-driven received_info/mandate; output per-agent probabilities and sampled states.
algorithms.Evaluation: For temporal holdout within 0..29: compute RMSE_aggregate, MAE_aggregate, Brier, and TransitionFit between simulated vs observed. For 30..39: if ground truth becomes available, compute same; otherwise report predicted aggregates and uncertainties.
